1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 75 cm de longitud, de cuerpo alargado y algo comprimido y aletas radiadas cuya coloración oscila entre el azul grisáceo y el amarillo; su carne es comestible. Carangidae; Caranx spp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish of up to 75 cm in length, with a elongated and slightly compressed body and radiated fins whose coloration ranges from grey-blue to yellow; its flesh is edible. Family Carangidae; genus Caranx spp.
